limitations: More features than initial training rows; ridge makes the fit possible, not trustworthy
Only one of six original big misses is scoreable; no general tail-performance claim
Previously examined history and current market vintages; not independent validation

specification.diesel: Remove 2022Q2 through 2023Q2 features from both training and scoring due survey break
specification.evaluation: All eligible matched quarters plus fixed six-big-miss coverage and error report; squared-error fitting without ex-post big-miss weighting; same-row simpler model and remove-best-benefit diagnostic
specification.missing_inputs: BLOCK; no zero fill, no future training, no changing feature subsets
specification.peer: Latest public overlapping fiscal period strictly before target quarter end; unexpected margins only
specification.promotion: Research only; existing gate; never automatic
specification.scope: Seven compatible research directions jointly, plus original market-change features; not every parameter of every failed model
specification.tail_claim: One scored big miss cannot establish systematic tail improvement
specification.target: Actual retail margin minus frozen original expanding-window production prediction
specification.training_regime: 2021 onward only; published earlier OOF residuals
specification.tuning: One model, no parameter grid or feature subset search
